the binary system (hexafluorothane + 1.1,1-trifuoroethane) has been studied in the temperature range from 258 to 328 K at pressures up to 3,89 MPa, and the experimental data have been correlated by the Peng-Robinson equation of state with the Mathias– Copeman alpha function, Wong–Sandler Mixing rules and NRTL cell theory.
